name: hypertask_tasks
does: Read, create, update, move, assign and relate tickets, including context, trees and description versions.
use_when: Use when working with a known ticket or a filtered board queue; list finds overdue work and context includes comments and recent activity.
do_not_use_when: Do not use for fuzzy text discovery or editing comments; use hypertask_search or hypertask_comments instead.
parameters_and_caveats: action selects an operation; input contains only that operation’s documented fields. response_format defaults to concise for reads; detailed retains full fields. limit defaults to 20 (maximum 50) and offset defaults to 0 for bounded read results; use returned pagination or narrower filters. Prefer ticket_number (for example HTPR-1234); get accepts identifier arrays, while context requires task_id and project_id. Normal, Archive and Deleted describe storage state, not workflow columns; section names describe workflow.

input.title: Fix the checkout retry
input.description: Reproduce the retry and add coverage.
